description: Help path A (plan section 4.6): the elder asked for Thornwick's winter cache back from the raiders in the quarry. Starts when the offer is 'cache'; the reward (120 XP, 2 iron, Ancestral Mend) is the elder's (dialogue.elder, once-flag reward.village.help). get_cache also accepts the later state (the cache handed over), because stages are checked in order. Abandoned without reward when the village's outcome is set to anything else.

stages.objective: Recover the stolen supplies from the Raider Quarry
Bring the supplies to Elder Maren
